P01.rationale: The founder is mentioned as a bottleneck but not visually represented; no portrait anchor exists.

P05.rationale: Each case study clearly frames and names the client (Conesso GmbH) with specific details in a meaningful size.

P07.rationale: A testimonial-style quote is present at the bottom of the right column, though it lacks a formal grid or rating card structure.

P10.rationale: The page features oversized decorative typographic elements like '04' and large numerals ('30', '2') that act as visual anchors.

P11.rationale: Real data-visualisations are present in the form of a clear before/after comparison showing time reduction from 30 to 2 minutes.

P12.rationale: The page reads as a dense, magazine-quality editorial layout that fills the sheet with text and structured sections.

P13.rationale: An intentional background texture/atmosphere is present through the subtle paper grain effect on the left column.

P14.rationale: While there are no full-bleed photos here, the dark blue panel acts as a treated area for text overlay, ensuring readability.

P16.rationale: No device/product mockup is shown; credibility relies on typography and data rather than product visualization.

N07.rationale: The imagery feels specific to the business context (text-heavy case study) but lacks generic stock photo elements entirely.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content across both columns.

N10.rationale: Text does not sit on busy photos without scrim; instead, text and graphics are cleanly separated into distinct zones.
